generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
The earnest money deposit of unsuccessful tenderers will be returned within 30 days of the end of the tender validity period specified in Sub-Clause 8.1.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
A copy of valid Electrical Inspectorate Department (Class-1) & above Registration Certificate.
A Copy of Valid EPF Registration Certificate.
A Copy of Valid ESI Registration Certificate.
Copy of Valid GST Registration Certificate.

Eligible Tenderers will be qualified only if their available tender capacity is more than total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as underAssessed available tender capacity-(AxNx2.5 -B )
A copy of Annual Turnover Certificate of financial years in the last 5 years reckoned back from 2024-25 (i.e., 2020-21 to 2024-25).

Branding & Identification: The manufacturers wordmark or name must be permanently engraved or embossed directly on the pressure die-cast aluminium housing body. Stickers, paint, or temporary labels will not be accepted.

Warranty Period: A comprehensive 2-year warranty against any manufacturing defects under standard operating electrical conditions must be provided by the luminaire manufacturer. The LED source must be exclusively from Cree, Nichia, Lumileds, or Osram.

Defect Rectification (Full Replacement): If any manufacturing, structural, or material defect is identified during the warranty period, the supplier must provide a complete body-to-body unit replacement (total fixture replacement) at no additional cost to the buyer. Component-level repairs or patchwork will not be permitted for material failures.

CCT greaterthan 5500K, IP66 optical and electrical compartment & impact resistance of complete luminaire greaterthan IK08.
